label: Support at a descriptive/plan point: A factual atom is supported when its factual valuation is…
definition: A factual atom is supported when its factual valuation is true; a forbidden-action atom when the permission plan assigns false; a conditional when its antecedent is unsupported or its consequent supported. The material conditional clause is stipulated and is not attributed to an unavailable primary text.
note: Analyst reconstruction for #185, motivated by the already pinned secondary account SEP-MORAL-COGNITIVISM §2.5. Exact conditional clauses and the psychological adequacy of compatible-state acceptance remain separate historical/fidelity obligations; see docs/expressivist-embedding-boundary.md. This models a possible planning language without asserting it is ordinary moral language.
